summary: Rigid or flexible shaft coupling with two M3 grub screws, body centred on the origin with the bore axis on z.

checks.source: SC 5x8 rigid coupling: body D 12.5, L 25, bores 5 and 8 (library list). M3 grub screws (3 mm long) sit 1 mm proud of the body at +y and -x, so x/y span body diameter + 1 mm of screw
SC 6x8 flex coupling: body D 19, L 25, bores 6 and 8 (library list); M3 grub screws sit 1 mm proud at +y and -x
